section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the procedure for a study involving female undergraduate students from a university psychology subject pool. Participants completed nightly online surveys for seven consecutive days (with an optional make-up survey on Day 8) between 4-11pm each evening, with credit awarded for timely completion. The study investigated personality, feelings, and body image.
